title: Academic Session 2026-27 Commencement
content: The academic session for all undergraduate programs has commenced. Students are advised to follow their respective timetables and attend classes regularly.

title: Attendance Requirement
content: Students are reminded that regular attendance is mandatory. Students with attendance below the required threshold should contact their course administrator.

title: Internal Assessment 1 Results
content: Internal Assessment 1 results have been published. Students should review their marks and contact the concerned faculty member for any clarification.

title: Assignment Submission Reminder
content: Students are reminded to complete and submit their assigned coursework before the respective deadlines shown in the student portal.

title: Independence Day Holiday
content: The institute will remain closed on Independence Day. Regular academic activities will resume on the next working day.

title: Student Technical Workshop
content: A technical workshop on emerging technologies will be conducted for interested students. Registration details will be shared through the student portal.

title: Attendance Review Notice
content: Students are advised to review their attendance records regularly and report any discrepancy to the concerned course administrator.

title: Internal Assessment 2 Schedule
content: The schedule for Internal Assessment 2 has been released. Students should check the examination section of the portal for subject-wise details.

title: Assignment Deadline Reminder
content: Students should ensure that all pending assignments are submitted before their respective deadlines. Late submissions may be subject to academic rules.

title: Faculty Interaction Session
content: A faculty interaction session will be organized to discuss academic progress attendance and student concerns.

title: Mid-Semester Academic Review
content: Course administrators will review academic performance attendance and pending coursework during the mid-semester academic review.

title: Student Feedback Drive
content: Students are encouraged to provide constructive feedback regarding teaching learning resources and academic services through the official portal.

title: End Semester Examination Notice
content: Students are informed that the end semester examination schedule has been published. Students should verify their examination dates times and rooms.

title: Examination Preparation Advisory
content: Students are advised to complete their syllabus revision and resolve academic queries with the concerned faculty before the end semester examinations.

title: Library Resource Update
content: New academic resources and reference materials have been added to the institute library. Students can check the library catalogue for available resources.

title: Placement Preparation Program
content: A placement preparation program covering aptitude technical skills and interview preparation will be conducted for eligible students.

title: Industry Interaction Session
content: An industry interaction session will be conducted to provide students with insights into current professional practices and career opportunities.

title: End Semester Examination Instructions
content: Students appearing for end semester examinations must carry their valid student identity card and follow all examination instructions issued by the institute.

title: Examination Hall Allocation
content: Students should check their examination hall allocation before each examination and report to the assigned room before the scheduled start time.

title: Semester Completion Notice
content: Students are advised to complete all pending academic requirements assignments and submissions before the semester completion deadline.
